cases.name: a screen of content directives
cases.play:
module Sales
  feature Orders
    slice StateView OrderList
      readmodel OrderRow
        id Uuid
        customer String
        total Decimal

      query AllOrders => observable OrderRow[]

      projection OrderRowProjection => OrderRow
        from OrderPlaced
          id = $eventSourceId

      screen Orders
        title "Orders"
        data OrderRow[] via query AllOrders
        table OrderRow
          column customer label "Customer"
          column total

cases.name: a screen of a summary
cases.play:
module Sales
  feature Orders
    slice StateView OrderDetail
      readmodel OrderDetailRow
        id Uuid
        customer String

      query OrderById => OrderDetailRow optional
        by id Uuid

      projection OrderDetailRowProjection => OrderDetailRow
        from OrderPlaced
          id = $eventSourceId

      screen OrderDetail
        title "Order"
        data OrderDetailRow via query OrderById by id
        summary OrderDetailRow
          field customer label "Customer"

cases.name: a screen that fills a blueprint template
cases.play:
module Sales
  feature Orders
    slice StateView OrderList
      readmodel OrderRow
        id Uuid
        customer String

      query AllOrders => observable OrderRow[]

      projection OrderRowProjection => OrderRow
        from OrderPlaced
          id = $eventSourceId

      screen Orders
        template blueprint Cratis.Blueprint.Default ListScreen version "^1"
          header
            component Cratis.Blueprint.Default.pageHeader ordersHeader
              property title = "Orders"
              property subtitle = "What has been ordered"
          list
            data OrderRow[] via query AllOrders
            table OrderRow
              column customer label "Customer"

cases.name: a screen with a toolbar of buttons
cases.play:
module Sales
  form PlaceOrderForm for PlaceOrder
    field customer label "Customer"

  feature Orders
    slice StateChange PlaceOrder
      command PlaceOrder
        id Uuid identifier
        customer String
        produces OrderPlaced
          for id
          customer = customer
      event OrderPlaced
        customer String

      screen PlaceOrder
        title "Place an order"
        action PlaceOrder

    slice StateView OrderList
      readmodel OrderRow
        id Uuid

      query AllOrders => observable OrderRow[]

      projection OrderRowProjection => OrderRow
        from OrderPlaced
          id = $eventSourceId

      screen Orders
        data OrderRow[] via query AllOrders
        toolbar actions
          button new title "New order" slice Sales.Orders.PlaceOrder emphasis primary icon plus

cases.name: a screen of a component with properties and a section
cases.play:
module Sales
  feature Orders
    slice StateView OrderBoard
      readmodel OrderRow
        id Uuid
        customer String

      query AllOrders => observable OrderRow[]

      projection OrderRowProjection => OrderRow
        from OrderPlaced
          id = $eventSourceId

      screen OrderBoard
        section summary
          component Cratis.Blueprint.Default.pageHeader boardHeader
            property title = "Board"
            property dense = true
            property columns = 3
          component Cratis.Components.card boardCard
            property name = "Board card"
            property body from customer

cases.name: screens of several roles and a screen of its own
cases.play:
persona Buyer
  description "Buys things"

persona Seller
  description "Sells things"

module Sales
  feature Orders
    slice StateView OrderList
      readmodel OrderRow
        id Uuid
        customer String

      query AllOrders => observable OrderRow[]

      projection OrderRowProjection => OrderRow
        from OrderPlaced
          id = $eventSourceId

      screen Buyer
        title "What you ordered"
        data OrderRow[] via query AllOrders

      screen Buyer__History
        title "Earlier orders"

      screen Seller
        title "What was ordered from you"

      screen OrderPrintout
        title "Printout"
